تصطلحن (form VIII)

# تُصْطَلَحْنَ (tuṣṭalaḥna) /tusˤ.tˤa.laħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
